title: The Day of the Runaway Toque
skyStory: A sliver of moon, five percent and grinning, is still loitering in Sagittarius with its boots on the dashboard. It wants adventure. It is November, so adventure means wind strong enough to steal a hat off a stranger and hand it to someone three streets over. Jupiter, the landlord of Sagittarius, is laughing too loudly at its own jokes again.

reading: The cabin has a draft, and the draft has opinions. Something you set down this morning will not be where you left it by noon. It has not been taken. It has wandered, the way a toque wanders in a gale, and it will come back when it gets bored.

Meanwhile, a small fire is asking to be built properly: kindling first, patience second, big logs last. That is your afternoon. One task, laid in order, lit once. The [[Knight of Pentacles]] is the slow horse in the deck and today it outruns everyone. Around 2:20 pm you will want to start a second thing. Put a log on the first one instead.
joel.mission: Find the oldest pen in the house and use it for every note today, out of respect for its long service.
joel.omen: A hat tumbling down the street on its own. Something you let go of is having a lovely time without you.
joel.stoneWhy: carry the spark in your pocket
joel.elementWhy: the gale is in charge today

reading: Sagittarius keeps throwing ideas at you like a kid tossing snowballs at a window. Most of them miss. One of them, around mid-morning, lands perfectly and makes a satisfying thunk. That is the one. You will know it because your hands start drawing it in the air before your mouth catches up.

The gift of the Rat today is spotting the shortcut nobody else sees: the side door, the faster queue, the button on the bottom row. Use it once, gleefully, then show one other person where it is. Helping someone level up is your favourite trick, and today it costs you exactly nine seconds.
nancy.mission: Teach somebody one tiny trick you know, like folding a fitted sheet or a keyboard shortcut, and accept the applause.
nancy.omen: A gutter dripping onto exactly the same spot all day. Small steady effort is wearing a path through something big.

together.text: Each of you choose a stranger's hat today and give it a secret name, like Captain Woolsworth or The Grand Pompom. Report back with the best one. The winner gets bragging rights until Friday and must use a pompous voice when claiming them.
